headline: Domain growth holds as Verisign raises full-year guidance
summary_short: Verisign's Q2 2026 revenue rose to $434.6M (+6.0% y/y) on continued .com/.net domain growth, with diluted EPS up to $2.38 from $2.21 and net income of $216.5M, while management said it is raising full-year 2026 guidance.
summary_long: Revenue grew 6.0% y/y to $434.6M on a 5.1% increase in the .com/.net domain base (179.1M names) and stronger new registrations (12.7M vs 10.4M a year ago). Operating income rose to $296.3M, though margin slipped slightly as SG&A (+11.8% y/y) outpaced revenue. Net income reached $216.5M and diluted EPS $2.38, both up from $207.4M/$2.21 a year ago. Cash and marketable securities climbed to $1.03B after Verisign issued $550M of 5.10% notes in June, used in July to redeem 4.75% 2027 notes, and repurchased $197M of stock. The board lifted the dividend to $0.81/share and expanded buyback authorization to $1.50B. Management said it is raising full-year 2026 guidance; this release gave no specific numeric range.

drivers.explanation: The .com/.net domain name base grew 5.1% y/y to 179.1M names, with 12.7M new registrations processed in the quarter vs 10.4M a year ago, plus a higher final .com/.net renewal rate (76.3% vs 75.5%).
Total costs and expenses rose 7.0% y/y (SG&A +11.8%, R&D +7.0%), slightly outpacing revenue's 6.0% growth, which trimmed operating margin even as operating income itself grew.
Tracks the same operating-income drivers above, plus $4.5M of non-operating income, net, which the operating-income line excludes.
Follows the operating-income increase; the effective tax rate was 23.1% ($65.1M/$281.6M) versus 22.4% a year earlier, a modest drag not further explained in the release.
Net income growth was amplified by a lower diluted share count (91.1M vs 94.0M y/y) from ongoing buybacks ($197M repurchased this quarter).

Verisign issued $550M of 5.10% notes due 2031 on June 26, 2026, before the June 30 quarter-end, while the offsetting redemption of the existing $550M 4.75% 2027 notes didn't occur until July 20 — after the quarter closed — temporarily inflating quarter-end cash alongside $232M of operating cash flow.
Six-month share repurchases ($426.8M) and dividends ($147.8M) together exceeded six-month net income ($431.0M) added to equity, deepening the stockholders' deficit despite continued profitability.

CEO Jim Bidzos highlighted 29 years of 100% .com/.net resolution uptime, returning "more than 100% of our free cash flow" via dividends and buybacks, the .web TLD's delegation into the DNS root zone, and raising full-year 2026 guidance (no numeric range disclosed here).
